about: The eight mesh tests of central-specs/docs/sb_helper_agent_mesh_setup.md §10.1 (keep the two in step): one per specialist (1–5), each reached ALONE through the entry point by the retry hint in the context ('retry: ask only <agent>'), and three for the orchestrator (6: one specialist; 7: two specialists merged into one report; 8: three specialists merged into one brief answer). Run: node --env-file=.env scripts/mesh-tests.mjs [--test] [--only 1,3] [--out replies.jsonl]; --direct prints, without connecting, the message to paste when a specialist is asked directly in the mesh (Agent Management → Chat with Agent). Figures marked 'extract' come from the February and March 2026 ClickHouse extract; 'approximate' ones are the documented order of magnitude; for an exact check replace each with the result of the test's confirm query, run as smartbuddy_agent_ro in Redshift.
exclusions: student traffic (the tx view: STYL test terminals, the PBS and SSSTM vendor codes, "Retrieve…" stalls and amounts over S$200 excluded)
